scope: Cache-only owner integration draft for review. Not compiled or tested; no shared promotion or CLI/public output change.
budget: Normal history IO derives from original startup remaining context. Expired/canceled startup creates one StopGrace+Reap envelope shared with core cleanup; history is capped500ms. No separate startup extension. Existing closeOwnedSession wrapper preserved; context helper never substitutes Background.
ownerVerification: Generic server has nil history; installed factory always derives separately admitted receipt binding without requiring a receipt FD.
Marker hook runs after actual protected entry outside operation state mutex, before receipt checks; all history warnings are nonfatal.
Terminal publication is in the sole worker after bootstrapForOperation actual completion; returned join includes publication and retirement.
Server retains actual store and warning; exact cleanup method has no arbitrary closer/path/PID inputs. Core Session/reaper lease transfer unchanged.
openBeforeTests: If the combined500ms fallback publication context expires before store.Close can retire publication/release the history duplicate, the server retains the store but genuine retry can remain blocked by that duplicate. Need explicitly reserved retirement time or reviewed quiescent lease release semantics; do not claim this draft satisfies that edge.
Lock-failure warning retention currently calls a blocking warning mutex; must prove no concurrent holder at these joined points or use a bounded state handoff.
Core completed error and successfully produced NATS status must remain primary; public historical warning retention is separate and not wired to CLI.
meaningfulTestsPlanned: Actual installed factory with/without receipt and generic server disabled.
Genuine entered operation marker and sole-worker completion before long-lived Run exits.
Malformed/unwritable history does not abort Bootstrap or demote valid authenticated NATS.
Canceled/expired startup shares single envelope with actual incomplete core cleanup and retains RuntimeCleanupError/service lease.
Actual staged EACCES owner survives Run; history duplicate release permits newer genuine attempt; cleanup preserves newer slot.
Exact remaining-budget expiry at publication/retirement boundary.
